name: @stillfail/station
description: The still.fail station in TypeScript (docs/station-ts.md); its native parts in native/

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts src/read/worker.ts src/search/worker.ts src/vault/use-index-worker.ts src/vault/signin-save-worker.ts src/usage/minute-worker.ts src/usage/retire-worker.ts src/usage/scope-worker.ts src/sessions/workspace-activity-worker.ts src/outflow/chat-index-worker.ts --outbase=src --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outdir=dist --external:*.node --banner:js="import { createRequire as __stillfailCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __stillfailCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && node --check dist/main.js && mkdir -p dist/skills && cp src/skills/*.md dist/skills/ && cp src/agents/dsh-bridge.mjs src/agents/cursor-bridge.mjs src/agents/sandbox-bridge.mjs src/screens/linux-portal.py src/screens/linux-x11.py src/screens/scrcpy-server dist/
scripts.test: node ../scripts/native.ts run mesh runner archive-rs -- node --import ./test/setup-env.mjs --test --test-timeout=600000 test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:side: node ../scripts/native.ts run mesh runner archive-rs -- node --import ./test/setup-env.mjs --test side/*.test.ts
